text.title: Hipaa Phi Data Flow Design Output Contract
text.summary: Draft-07 JSON Schema for the PHI data-flow design: every hop with its §164.514(b)(2) identifier classes and justified fields, a BAA (plan and covered service) on every external hop that receives identified PHI, TLS 1.2+ per link with its termination point, KMS-managed encryption at rest per store, the append-only PHI-free audit log retained six years, the allow-list log scrubber with its synthetic-record test, unique identities and roles per hop with automatic logoff and break-glass, retention and deletion propagation per store, and the Security Officer sign-off. Validator: `scripts/validate-hipaa-phi-data-flow-design.py`.

section.title: JSON Schema (draft-07)
section.note: What the schema cannot express and the reviewer checks by hand: every store, queue, cache, index, log pipeline, error tracker, backup, export and third-party API in the infrastructure inventory has a hop (r-phi-every-hop-inventoried); every `links[].from` / `to` names a hop, and a link exists for every pair of hops that exchange PHI including inside the VPC (r-phi-encrypted-in-transit-and-at-rest); a `deidentified` hop's `identifier_classes` is empty under Safe Harbor (r-phi-minimum-necessary-per-hop); `deletion_propagation[].propagates_to` covers every backup, replica, cache, index and export hop (r-phi-retention-and-deletion-per-store); the `synthetic_record_test` actually writes a record through every request path listed in the routing table (r-phi-never-in-logs-errors-or-urls).

example.note: Subject violations: full clinical notes sent identified to an embeddings API with no BAA and no documented identified use (r-phi-baa-for-every-external-hop, r-phi-minimum-necessary-per-hop); the database hop stores PHI with no encryption at rest and the internal link runs TLS 1.0 terminated at the edge (r-phi-encrypted-in-transit-and-at-rest); a shared `ops` account with no automatic logoff (r-phi-unique-identity-and-role-access); an audit log that is the application log, mutable, carrying field values, kept one year and missing identity and record id (r-phi-audit-event-per-access); no scrubber, PHI in URLs and a synthetic test that neither covers every path nor runs in CI (r-phi-never-in-logs-errors-or-urls); no deletion propagation and no disposal procedure (r-phi-retention-and-deletion-per-store); and a design approved by the agent with no Security Officer.

antipattern.description: An `external` hop with `deidentified = false` and no `baa`, a `baa` naming only the vendor without `plan` and `covered_service`, or an analytics, ML or LLM hop receiving identified PHI without `identified_use_documented_at`.
antipattern.reason: r-phi-baa-for-every-external-hop, r-phi-minimum-necessary-per-hop: disclosure without a BAA is a violation regardless of the vendor's security.

antipattern.description: A store, queue, cache, index, log pipeline, error tracker, backup, export or SaaS integration in the infrastructure inventory with no entry in `hops`.
antipattern.reason: r-phi-every-hop-inventoried: the hops that cause breaches are the ones nobody drew.

antipattern.description: `phi_in_urls_or_query_strings` true, no `allow_list_scrubber_at`, or a `synthetic_record_test` that does not cover every request path or run in CI.
antipattern.reason: r-phi-never-in-logs-errors-or-urls: logs and error trackers are the hops that never get a BAA.

antipattern.description: A link with `tls_version` below 1.2 or `tls_terminates_at` the load balancer only; a storing hop without `encryption_at_rest` via a KMS with rotation.
antipattern.reason: r-phi-encrypted-in-transit-and-at-rest: PHI encrypted per the HHS guidance is not a reportable breach when lost.

antipattern.description: `shared_accounts` true, an empty `roles` list, `auto_logoff_minutes` 0, or no `break_glass` with its own alert.
antipattern.reason: r-phi-unique-identity-and-role-access: a shared login makes the audit log worthless.

antipattern.description: `audit_log.contains_phi_field_values` true, `append_only` false, `retention_years` below 6, or `event_fields` missing identity, timestamp, record id, action or originating system.
antipattern.reason: r-phi-audit-event-per-access: the audit store must not become the widest-read PHI store.

antipattern.description: A hop without `retention`, `deletion_propagation` empty or not reaching every backup, replica, cache, index and export, or no `media_disposal_procedure`.
antipattern.reason: r-phi-retention-and-deletion-per-store: retention must be a property of the system, not a promise.

antipattern.description: `review.status = approved` with no `security_officer` and `signed_on`, or `approved_by_agent` true.
antipattern.reason: Human checkpoint in `03-failure-modes.xml`: the Security or Privacy Officer signs before PHI flows.
